notes: Every value is synthetic. No organization, credential, account, token, storage key or private URL appears.
Scenarios are independent branches of one story; ids, sequences and instants agree within one scenario only.
Provider facts (maxStepUnits, maxStepDeadlineMs) are fixture values, not the declared facts of a real adapter.
Cancel and delete fixtures bind against responses.acceptedResult.body.schedule (S1, ACTIVE, scheduleVersion 1) plus the stored dispatches listed with the request.

responses.cancelRemainingPendingResult, cancelRemainingAgainResult, cancelSeriesAfterTruncationResult and deleteAfterTruncationResult branch from one further state of S1: occurrence 0 published, occurrence 1 pending. cancelRemainingPendingResult truncates it (the first end request); cancelRemainingAgainResult and then cancelSeriesAfterTruncationResult follow it, while deleteAfterTruncationResult is an alternative to cancelRemainingAgainResult. Each states only what the contract accepts; none is a recorded runtime answer.

digests.note: Every sha256 / sha256:<hex> value is a format-only fixture digest (one 4-hex unit starting with fd, repeated 16 times). None is computed over anything and none may be compared with a real digest. Separately computed hash vectors belong in their own fixture; hashInputs holds the exact objects the contract hashes, without digests.

urls.note: Only an example.com (RFC 2606) public release URL appears.

resolved.responses.deleteDraftResult: P1-A, resolved: a DELETE result (and its lookup) for a never-scheduled DRAFT is accepted at schedule generation 0, and only it; its lookup's currentScheduleGeneration can never be lower than the result's.
resolved.responses.cancelRemainingAgainResult: P2, resolved: a schedule keeps its first end request through a later REMAINING cancel, which only lowers lastOccurrence under a new schedule version.
resolved.responses.cancelSeriesAfterTruncationRes: P2, resolved: a CANCELLED schedule keeps its first end request while endedOperationKey names the later cancel that ended it.
resolved.responses.deleteAfterTruncationResult: P2, resolved: a SUPERSEDED_BY_DELETE (or HALTED) schedule may keep an earlier end request.
resolved.responses.cancelRemainingPendingResult: P2, resolved: ENDS_AFTER_REMAINING names a truncated series that still has an earlier pending occurrence or future occurrences up to lastOccurrence; ENDS_AFTER_IN_FLIGHT stays for an admitted or unresolved remainder only.
resolved.responses.releasePreviewParagraph: Resolved: a cover carries byteLength and mimeType under the same bounds as its media, so the release hash binds them.
